# String Prairie Heating & Air

> Family-owned and operated residential & commercial HVAC contractor serving Bastrop County and Central Texas since 2014.

## Contact & Business Details
- **Business Name**: String Prairie Heating & Air
- **Owner**: Ron M. Hammons
- **Phone**: (512) 924-9744
- **Location**: Rosanky, TX 78953 (serving all of Bastrop County, TX)
- **Hours**: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Emergency HVAC service available)
- **Website**: https://stringprairieheatingandair.com
- **Online Booking**: https://book.housecallpro.com/book/String-Prairie-Heating--Air/df82ded280ce43f4a9ee6ee6d36aef76?v2=true
